data.one_liner: A Flutter FormField widget to input a DateRange using showDateRangePicker.
data.what_it_does: Provides a DateRangeField widget that integrates Flutter's showDateRangePicker into standard forms. It accepts an InputDecoration, supports validation, custom date formatting, and handles saving date ranges natively.
use_when: You need users to pick a date range inside a standard Flutter Form
You want to validate a selected start and end date before form submission
avoid_when: You are building a custom calendar view rather than a form field input
You do not need FormField integration and can directly invoke showDateRangePicker
strengths: Seamless integration with Flutter Form state management and validation
Supports customizable InputDecoration and date formats
weaknesses: Limited to date range pickers via showDateRangePicker
data.minimal_example:
DateRangeField(
  decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: 'Date Range'),
  validator: (value) => value == null ? 'Please select a date range' : null,
  onSaved: (value) {},
)
